in_sanskrit.name: हरि
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who removes all sorrows and bestows happiness

in_marathi.name: Haripreet
in_marathi.long_meaning: Haripreet हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Haripreet is a Sanskrit name that combines 'Hari' (God) and 'Preet' (joy or love). This name symbolizes the joy and love one experiences in the presence of God.
